## What is it?

**pandas** is a Python package that provides fast, flexible, and expressive datastructures
designed to make working with "relational" or "labeled" data botheasy and intuitive.
It aims to be the fundamental high-level building block fordoing practical, **real-world**
data analysis in Python. Additionally, it hasthe broader goal of becoming **the most
powerful and flexible open-source dataanalysis/manipulation tool available in any
language**. It is already well onits way towards this goal.

## Main Features

Here are just a few of the things that pandas does well:

- Easy handling of [**missing data**](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") (represented as`NaN`, `NA`, or `NaT`) in floating point as well as non-floating point data
- Size mutability: columns can be [**inserted anddeleted**](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") from DataFrame and higher dimensionalobjects
- Automatic and explicit [**data alignment**](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous"): objects canbe explicitly aligned to a set of labels, or the user can simplyignore the labels and let `Series`, `DataFrame`, etc. automaticallyalign the data for you in computations
- Powerful, flexible [**group by**](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") functionality to performsplit-apply-combine operations on data sets, for both aggregatingand transforming data
- Make it [**easy to convert**](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") ragged,differently-indexed data in other Python and NumPy data structuresinto DataFrame objects
- Intelligent label-based [**slicing**](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous"), [**fancyindexing**](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous"), and [**subsetting**](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") oflarge data sets
- Intuitive [**merging**](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") and [**joining**](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") datasets
- Flexible [**reshaping**](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") and [**pivoting**](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") ofdata sets
- [**Hierarchical**](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") labeling of axes (possible to have multiplelabels per tick)
- Robust I/O tools for loading data from [**flat files**](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous")(CSV and delimited), [**Excel files**](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous"), [**databases**](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous"),and saving/loading data from the ultrafast [**HDF5 format**](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous")
- [**Time series**](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous")-specific functionality: date rangegeneration and frequency conversion, moving window statistics,date shifting and lagging


## Where to get it

The source code is currently hosted on GitHub at:[https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous")

Binary installers for the latest released version are available at the [PythonPackage Index (PyPI)](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") and on [Conda](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous").

```# condaconda install -c conda-forge pandas```

                              

```# or PyPIpip install pandas```


The list of changes to pandas between each release can be found[here](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous"). For fulldetails, see the commit logs at [https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous").


## Dependencies

- [NumPy - Adds support for large, multi-dimensional arrays, matrices and high-level mathematical functions to operate on these arrays](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous")
- [python-dateutil - Provides powerful extensions to the standard datetime module](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous")
- [tzdata - Provides an IANA time zone database](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") (Only required on Windows/Emscripten)

See the [full installation instructions](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") for minimum supported versions of required, recommended and optional dependencies.


## Installation from sources

To install pandas from source you need [Cython](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") in addition to the normaldependencies above. Cython can be installed from PyPI:

```pip install cython```

                              
In the `pandas` directory (same one where you found this file aftercloning the git repo), 
execute:

```pip install .```


or for installing in [development mode](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous"):

```python -m pip install -ve . --no-build-isolation --config-settings editable-verbose=true```

                              
See the full instructions for [installing from source](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous").

## Documentation

The official documentation is hosted on [PyData.org](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous").


## Background

Work on `pandas` started at [AQR](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") (a quantitative hedge fund) in 2008 andhas been under active development since then.


## Getting Help

For usage questions, the best place to go to is [Stack Overflow](https://github.githubassets.com "anonymous").Further, general questions and discussions can also take place on the [pydata mailing list](https://github.githubassets.com "anonymous").


## Discussion and Development

Most development discussions take place on GitHub in this repo, via the [GitHub issue tracker](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous").

Further, the [pandas-dev mailing list](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") can also be used for specialized discussions or design issues, and a [Slack channel](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") is available for quick development related questions.

There are also frequent [community meetings](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") for project maintainers open to the community as well as monthly [new contributor meetings](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") to help support new contributors.

Additional information on the communication channels can be found on the [contributor community](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") page.


## Contributing to pandas

[![](https://github.githubassets.com/images/spinners/octocat-spinner-darkmode.svg "anonymous")](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous")


All contributions, bug reports, bug fixes, documentation improvements, enhancements, 
and ideas are welcome.

A detailed overview on how to contribute can be found in the **[contributing guide](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css
"anonymous")**.

You can also triage issues which may include reproducing bug reports, or asking for 
vital information such as version numbers or reproduction instructions. If you would 
like to start triaging issues, one easy way to get started is to [subscribe to pandas on CodeTriage](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous").

Or maybe through using pandas you have an idea of your own or are looking for something 
in the documentation and thinking ‘this can be improved’... you can do something 
about it!

Feel free to ask questions on the [mailing list](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous") or on [Slack](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous").

As contributors and maintainers to this project, you are expected to abide by pandas' 
code of conduct. More information can be found at: [Contributor Code of Conduct](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous")

---

[Go to Top](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous")


## About

Flexible and powerful data analysis / manipulation library for Python, providing 
labeled data structures similar to R data.frame objects, statistical functions, and 
much more

[pandas.pydata.org](https://github.githubassets.com/assets/light_high_contrast-48fdd0811afbab3c.css "anonymous")
